verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API for interacting with the application, including concrete endpoints for pulling experiment results and toggling features from scripts, plus a confirmation control for risky changes. Its official MCP server is built on authenticated calls to that same REST API, which shows the API is meant for programmatic and agent use. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage and reliability.
